article.headline: Thiam scores 13 as High Point knocks off Carolina University 99-31
article.description: — Abdoulaye Thiam scored 13 points to help High Point defeat Carolina University 99-31 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Thiam scores 13 as High Point knocks off Carolina University 99-31
article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Abdoulaye Thiam scored 13 points to help High Point defeat Carolina University 99-31 on Tuesday night. Thiam shot 5 for 7, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc for the Panthers (11-2). Kimani Hamilton scored 11 points and added five rebounds. Chase Johnston shot 4 for 7, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points, while adding four steals. Cameron Buchanan finished with six points for the Bruins. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
